find: unless it reasonably forecasts material and substantial disruption
replace: absent actual or reasonably forecast material and substantial disruption of schoolwork or discipline, or an invasion of the rights of others
reason: Tinker separately identified substantial disruption and invasion of the rights of others. The original made a forecast of disruption the only permissible basis.

find: reasonably forecasting ``material and substantial disruption'' rather than mere undifferentiated fear
replace: reasonably forecasting material and substantial disruption rather than mere undifferentiated fear
reason: The quoted phrase is a paraphrase. Tinker used materially and substantially disrupt and material and substantial interference.

find: joined by Chief Justice Warren and Justices Douglas, Brennan, White, and Marshall.
replace: joined by Chief Justice Warren and Justices Douglas, Brennan, Stewart, White, and Marshall.
reason: In a 7--2 decision with only Black and Harlan dissenting, the majority had six joiners plus Fortas. Stewart filed an opinion styled 'concurring' (not 'concurring in the result'), as White did, and the brief already counts White as a joiner. The official report prints no join list, so this follows the standard alignment and the vote count.
source: official opinion text, U.S. pages 514--515 (Stewart, J., concurring; White, J., concurring); U.S. page 515 onward (dissents of Black and Harlan)
